economic_hypothesis: In a causal broad BULL state with majority-positive PIT industry participation, the first upper-limit close in twenty completed sessions can reveal demand left unsatisfied by the price-limit constraint. A bounded prior range, limited prior appreciation and turnover expansion distinguish fresh ignition from late acceleration.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

selection.order: median annual mean, pooled mean, severe10, simplicity

signal.first_in_20: zero upper-limit closes in prior20 completed valid sessions
signal.limit_close: raw close rounded to cents >= historical upper limit
signal.prior_range: prior20 coordinate high / prior20 coordinate low - 1
